rationale: Any of the three could in principle produce this outcome. Deleting the gene might impair CD8+ fitness, the degrader might be toxic at micromolar doses over three days, and the inhibitor might block a catalytic function that CD8+ cells need; the premises do not clearly separate these possibilities. On balance I lean towards the catalytic inhibitor, though I would not be surprised if the degrader were the right answer, and the knockout cannot be fully excluded either.
